summary.headline: Alcochoden and the Native’s Mind
summary.text: Rules for calculating the Alcochoden’s years from benefic and malefic aspects, including Mercury’s effects, followed by Chapter V on judging the native’s mind through the ascendant lord and Mercury in movable or common signs.
